description: Drag one element onto another: move a card to a column, reorder a list, drop an item into a folder. Both ends in the same frame. For canvas points use click_at with to_x and to_y. A drop onto something that deletes asks the user first.

from.description: The element to pick up: a ref like "e14", or its exact visible text when the outline gives it no ref.

position.description: Drop just before or after the target (reordering) instead of on its middle.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

to.description: Where to drop it: a ref, or visible text such as a column heading ("Done").

name: drag
title: Drag an element onto another
